overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.p1: By purchasing a SAFT (Simple Agreement for Future Tokens) on this platform, you acknowledge and agree that:
overview.li1: The SAFT represents a contractual right to receive tokens in the future, not immediate ownership of any physical asset.
overview.li2: The tokens, once issued, will represent a fractional interest in a digital claim to an underlying asset (the Fabergé egg) held by a partner entity.
overview.li3: The SAFT and future tokens do not constitute direct ownership of the Fabergé egg.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility and Restricted Jurisdictions
eligibility.p1: Participation in this SAFT offering is strictly limited to individuals who are legally permitted to purchase in their jurisdiction.
eligibility.p2: By purchasing, you confirm that you are not a resident, citizen, or otherwise subject to the laws of any of the following restricted jurisdictions:
eligibility.p3: Restricted Jurisdictions include, but are not limited to:
eligibility.r1: United States of America (all states and territories)
eligibility.r2: China (including Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR if local regulations prohibit)
eligibility.r6: Japan (unless local regulatory approval is obtained)
eligibility.r7: Other countries where offering or marketing SAFTs or tokens is prohibited under applicable law
eligibility.p4: The list of restricted jurisdictions may be updated at any time. It is your responsibility to ensure you are eligible before purchasing.
eligibility.l1: Purchasers must comply with all local laws and restrictions.
eligibility.l2: The platform may use IP geolocation, billing address, language detection, or other verification methods to block restricted jurisdictions.
eligibility.l3: If you are located in a restricted jurisdiction, you may not access this page or participate in the SAFT sale.

delivery.title: 3. No Guarantee of Token Delivery or Value
delivery.l0: Token issuance is subject to legal, regulatory, and operational conditions.
delivery.l2: Delivery of tokens by a specific date.
delivery.l3: Any specific value of the tokens once issued.
delivery.l4: Tokens may be illiquid, and there is no assurance of resale or market price.

risks.title: 4. Risk Disclosures
risks.p1: By participating, you acknowledge and accept the following risks:
risks.r1: Regulatory Risk – Tokens may be classified as securities or other regulated instruments in some jurisdictions.
risks.r2: Contractual Risk – Tokens are backed by a partnership agreement; failure of the partner to perform may result in loss of value.
risks.r3: Asset Risk – The underlying Fabergé egg may be damaged, lost, or otherwise unavailable.
risks.r4: Liquidity Risk – There is no guarantee that a market will exist for the tokens.
risks.r5: Tax Risk – Purchasers are responsible for all tax reporting and obligations in their jurisdiction.
risks.r6: Operational Risk – Delivery of tokens may be delayed or fail due to technical, legal, or administrative reasons.

jurisdiction.title: 5. Acknowledgment of Jurisdiction Restrictions
jurisdiction.l1: The sale and these Terms are intended only for individuals who can legally participate in approved jurisdictions.
jurisdiction.l2: Do not proceed if you are a resident, citizen, or accessing this page from a restricted jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.l3: The platform reserves the right to refuse access or reverse transactions based on IP, billing address, language, or other verification methods.

disclaimer.title: 6. No Advice or Representation
disclaimer.l1: The information on this page is for informational purposes only.
disclaimer.l2: This is not an offer, solicitation, or investment advice.
disclaimer.l3: You are responsible for conducting your own due diligence and consulting legal or financial advisors.

accept.title: 7. Acceptance of Terms

accept.l2: Acknowledge that you accept all the risks described above.

hero.mainTitle: For the first time, a Fabergé egg {br} is offered for fractional ownership!
hero.description1: The first three million ownership shares are already available with a 66% discount. Grab your share while it's still available!
hero.description2: Fabergé collectible eggs increase in value every year and sell for tens of millions.
hero.description3: We were lucky to find one of these eggs in a private collection.
hero.description4: Ownership rights to this egg are divided into 100 million parts - fractions.

features.item1: Opportunity to resell fractions at market price after all 100 million shares are sold at the global Christmas auction!
features.item2: The egg was created by a master craftsman of the House of Fabergé at the end of the 19th century. Expertise confirms authenticity!
features.item3: After transitioning to shared ownership, the artwork will be stored in a specialized freeport facility.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.question1: How will the auction be conducted?
faq.answer1: For the first time, an item of this caliber will be available to retail investors through our fractional ownership mechanism. The auction won't offer the entire object, but rather its FCC, divided into 200 lots, each containing different quantities of ownership shares, which we call fractions.
faq.answer2: This is a special type of crypto certificate - Fractional Crypto Certificate - that we created for precise identification of physical assets, enabling their almost instant resale, similar to the NFT market. FCC also provides the ability to own 'fractions' as shares of expensive assets.
faq.question3: What kind of expertise is required?
faq.answer3: There are several respected institutions and specialists in the world who can verify the authenticity of works from Karl Fabergé's workshop. We're currently in dialogue with two of them. We'll share all the details in our social media channels.
faq.question4: How can I manage my ownership shares?
faq.answer4: On our CoArt Marketplace, you'll be able to sell and resell both unique physical objects in their entirety and ownership shares of them as 'fractions' of specific FCCs.
faq.question5: Where will the Egg itself be stored?
faq.answer5: After the auction concludes, the object itself will be exhibited in one of the European museums or transferred for safekeeping to one of the specialized 'freeports'.
